$comment: Extensions the DESIGN.md frontmatter cannot hold: shadows, motion, breakpoints, and the narrative. Regenerate alongside DESIGN.md.
antiReference: The GA4 report wall, and interface metaphors that need explaining (the previous smoked-drum design).

audiences.rule: Blue is people, orange is AI, on every surface; never colour alone.

elevation.philosophy: Hairline edge plus soft offset shadow. No glow.

focus: 2px solid #2f6bff outline, 2px offset; inputs: blue border plus 0 0 0 3px rgba(47,107,255,.1)

motion.philosophy: A few useful first-appearance moments. Complete without motion; none under prefers-reduced-motion.
moments: Hero chart draws in left to right (clip-path), held from first paint by html.hm
Hero figures tick from 86% to their value
Live feed adds a visit every 2.6s while visible and the tab is shown
Homepage feature visuals build once when scrolled into view
App charts draw in on first view and on range change
